title: A VR Training System for Robot-Assisted Vascular Intervention with Dual-Mode Control and Model-Based Interaction Response
summary: Virtual reality training for robot-assisted vascular intervention requires accurate robotic control and effective feedback on guidewire--vessel interactions. This paper presents a VR training system combining asynchronous dual-mode command mapping with sensorless interaction estimation. The system supports velocity-controlled navigation and position-driven incremental manipulation. Guidewire deformation and a Hunt--Crossley-type contact response are combined and temporally filtered to estimate interaction intensity, while trajectory-based visualization supports post-procedure review. Tests confirmed distinct command-dispatch patterns across three velocity gears and the position mode. During hybrid-scene navigation, the estimated response remained low during straight insertion and increased as the guidewire bent within the vascular model. Trajectory analysis yielded a model-derived cumulative trauma work (CTW) value of 15.166 in normalized units and localized regions of elevated interaction. In a preliminary study with 15 novices, physical-phantom task success increased from 53.3% to 93.3% after VR training, while mean completion time decreased from 132.4 s to 96.7 s. These results demonstrate the system's dual-mode operation, deformation-sensitive feedback, and potential to improve subsequent physical-phantom task performance.
tldr: This paper presents a VR training system for robot-assisted vascular intervention that combines asynchronous dual-mode control (velocity and position) with sensorless, model-based estimation of guidewire-vessel interaction forces. A preliminary study with 15 novices shows improved physical-phantom task success and reduced completion time after VR training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人辅助血管介入手术的虚拟现实训练系统，结合异步双模式控制（速度与位置）以及基于模型的无传感器导丝-血管交互力估计。初步实验显示，15名新手经VR训练后，实体模型任务成功率提升、完成时间缩短。
summary_zh: 虚拟现实培训用于机器人辅助血管介入需要精确的机器人控制以及对导丝-血管相互作用的有效反馈。本文提出了一种将异步双模式命令映射与无传感器交互估计相结合的VR培训系统。该系统支持速度控制导航和位置驱动增量操作。将导丝变形与Hunt-Crossley型接触响应相结合并进行时间滤波，以估计交互强度，同时基于轨迹的可视化支持术后回顾。测试确认了三种速度档位和位置模式下不同的命令调度模式。在混合场景导航过程中，直线插入时估计响应保持较低，而导丝在血管模型内弯曲时响应增大。轨迹分析得出模型推导的累积创伤功（CTW）值为15.166（归一化单位），并定位了交互增强的局部区域。在一项涉及15名新手的初步研究中，经过VR培训后，物理体模任务成功率从53.3%提升至93.3%，平均完成时间从132.4秒缩短至96.7秒。这些结果表明，该系统具备双模式操作、变形敏感反馈，并有望改善后续物理体模任务表现。

title: Learning When to Trust Medical Knowledge: Regression-Safe Routing for Clinical Reasoning
summary: Clinical reasoning LLMs need external medical knowledge, but retrieved evidence and reasoning chains can be outdated, poisoned, or hallucinated. Harmful knowledge can cause regression: changing a correct answer into an incorrect one. We construct a medical knowledge-poisoning benchmark covering retrieved evidence and reasoning chains, with seven attack families filtered by a three-judge "subtle-but-wrong" vote and paired clean exams that separate poisoning effects from question difficulty. No fixed knowledge-use strategy is robust across these settings: strong RAG methods trade robustness to poisoned evidence against accuracy when evidence is useful. We formulate knowledge use as per-instance routing and introduce Med-TrustRouter, a lightweight controller that keeps the solver frozen. From leakage-free runtime signals, it estimates each action's expected correctness gain and uncertainty, preserving the base answer unless another action is confidently better. Across seven medical reasoning settings, Med-TrustRouter achieves 78.9 macro and 69.2 worst-case accuracy, matching the strongest competitor on macro accuracy while substantially improving the worst-case floor. Its gains transfer across solvers and evidence judges, unlike a hand-coded router using the same signals. Similar performance across linear, tree, and neural action-value heads suggests that the benefit comes from routing rather than estimator complexity. These results support learning when to trust external knowledge for robust clinical reasoning.
tldr: Proposes Med-TrustRouter, a lightweight per-instance router that decides whether to use external medical knowledge in clinical reasoning LLMs to prevent regression from poisoned or hallucinated knowledge; a benchmark with seven attack families shows it improves worst-case accuracy while matching strong competitors on macro accuracy.
tldr_zh: 提出 Med-TrustRouter，一种轻量级按实例路由控制器，用于在临床推理 LLM 中决定是否使用外部医学知识，以避免被污染或幻觉知识导致正确回答回归；在包含七类攻击的基准上，该方法在匹配最强基线平均精度的同时显著提升最差情况准确性。
summary_zh: 临床推理大语言模型需要外部医学知识，但检索到的证据和推理链可能过时、被投毒或产生幻觉。有害知识可能导致性能回退：将正确答案变为错误答案。我们构建了一个涵盖检索证据和推理链的医学知识投毒基准，包含七类攻击，通过三裁判“微妙但错误”投票机制筛选，并配对了干净的考试题以区分投毒效应与题目难度。在所有这些设置中，没有任何固定的知识使用策略是稳健的：强检索增强生成（RAG）方法在证据有用时，会在对投毒证据的稳健性与准确性之间进行权衡。我们将知识使用表述为逐实例路由，并引入了Med-TrustRouter，一个保持求解器冻结的轻量级控制器。它从无泄漏的运行时信号中估计每个动作的预期正确性增益和不确定性，除非另一个动作在置信度上明显更优，否则保留基础答案。在七个医学推理设置中，Med-TrustRouter取得了78.9的宏平均准确率和69.2的最差情况准确率，在宏平均准确率上与最强竞争对手持平，同时显著提升了最差情况的下限。与使用相同信号的手工编码路由器不同，其收益可跨求解器和证据评判器迁移。线性、树状和神经动作值头之间的性能相似，表明收益来自路由而非估计器复杂度。这些结果支持学习何时信任外部知识以实现稳健的临床推理。

title: Feasibility of a Patient-Specific Digital Twin for Ventriculoperitoneal Shunt Trajectory Planning
summary: Catheter obstruction is the commonest cause of shunt failure; freehand insertion at Keen's point leaves the tip free in cerebrospinal fluid in only one case in ten. We built a digital twin that reconstructs skull, scalp, ear and ventricles from preoperative CT by deterministic geometry, searches every entry around Keen's point for the perpendicular trajectory with the longest intraventricular length under safety constraints, and returns the plan as two ruler measurements from the ear and two depths. Executed freehand in 11 consecutive adults (IDEAL Stage 2a), it achieved Hayhurst Grade 1 placement in 10 of 11 against 22 of 213 historically (p = 9 x 10^-9), median entry and angular deviations 2.5 mm and 5.9 degrees, 1.4 cm more intraventricular catheter than Keen's point, and no intraoperative complication. The technique was unchanged; the gain came from choosing entry and depth per patient. Whether it lowers revision is the next stage's hypothesis.
tldr: A deterministic CT-based digital twin plans individualized ventriculoperitoneal shunt trajectories around Keen's point, improving freehand Hayhurst Grade 1 catheter placement from ~10% historically to 10/11 in a small prospective cohort.
tldr_zh: 利用术前CT构建确定性数字孪生，为脑室-腹腔分流术规划绕过Keen点的个体化穿刺路径；在11例患者中10例达到Hayhurst 1级放置，较历史约10%的成功率显著提高。
summary_zh: 导管阻塞是分流失败最常见的原因；在Keen点徒手置入时，仅十分之一的病例导管尖端能游离于脑脊液中。我们构建了一个数字孪生模型，通过确定性几何从术前CT重建颅骨、头皮、耳及脑室，在Keen点周围搜索每个入点，寻找在安全约束下脑室内长度最长的垂直轨迹，并以从耳部的两个尺规测量值及两个深度作为规划结果。在连续11例成人患者中徒手实施（IDEAL 2a期），10/11达到Hayhurst 1级置入，而历史对照为22/213（p = 9 x 10^-9），入点中位偏差2.5 mm，角度中位偏差5.9度，脑室内导管长度比Keen点入路多1.4 cm，且无术中并发症。技术本身未变；改进来自针对每位患者选择入点和深度。是否能降低翻修率是下一阶段的研究假设。

title: Taking the PULSE of Medical Reasoning: Step-Level Retrieval Timing for Knowledge-Grounded Inference
summary: Reliable medical reasoning requires LLMs to dynamically access external biomedical evidence to improve factual trustworthiness and reasoning accuracy. However, indiscriminate retrieval can introduce noise and latency, raising a critical retrieval-timing problem: at each reasoning step, the system must decide whether the model's internal knowledge is reliable or external evidence is needed. We propose PUlSE, a lightweight probing method that uses the model's internal representations as intrinsic signals for step-level retrieval control. Our posterior trajectory analysis reveals that erroneous steps exhibit substantially higher inter-layer volatility than correct ones, suggesting unstable internal knowledge. Based on this finding, PUlSE trains a compact probe on inter-layer geometric features to detect factual errors upon step completion, and uses it as an adaptive trigger for retrieval and step regeneration. Across four medical benchmarks, PUlSE-timed retrieval matches exhaustive per-step retrieval in accuracy while reducing retrieval calls by 72%, and can transfer to an unseen legal domain, indicating potential domain-agnostic generality. Overall, our study provides an initial step toward shifting retrieval-trigger design from surface-level confidence estimates to internal activation dynamics for adaptive access.
tldr: Proposes PUlSE, a probe trained on LLM inter-layer activation volatility to detect erroneous steps in medical reasoning and trigger external retrieval only when needed, reducing retrieval calls by 72% while matching exhaustive retrieval accuracy across medical benchmarks and transferring to an unseen legal domain.
tldr_zh: 提出PUlSE，利用LLM跨层激活的波动性训练轻量探针，在医学推理步骤完成后判断是否需要外部检索；在四个医学基准上以72%更少的检索调用达到与逐步骤全量检索相当的准确率，并迁移到法律领域。
summary_zh: 可靠的医学推理要求大型语言模型动态访问外部生物医学证据，以提高事实可信度和推理准确性。然而，不加区分地检索会引入噪声和延迟，从而引发一个关键的检索时机问题：在每个推理步骤中，系统必须判断模型的内部知识是否可靠，或者是否需要外部证据。我们提出了PUlSE，一种轻量级探测方法，利用模型的内部表示作为步骤级检索控制的内在信号。我们的后验轨迹分析表明，错误步骤在层间波动性上显著高于正确步骤，这表明其内部知识不稳定。基于这一发现，PUlSE在层间几何特征上训练一个紧凑的探测器，在步骤完成时检测事实错误，并将其用作检索和步骤重新生成的自适应触发器。在四个医学基准上，PUlSE定时检索在准确性与逐步全面检索相当的同时，将检索调用减少了72%，并且能够迁移到未见过的法律领域，表明其具有潜在的跨领域通用性。总体而言，我们的研究为将检索触发设计从表面置信度估计转向基于内部激活动态的自适应访问迈出了初步一步。

title: Full-Order Safety for Nonlinear Reduced-Order MPC
summary: Reduced-order models (ROMs) make model predictive control (MPC) of high-dimensional nonlinear systems tractable, but the resulting modeling error can lead to constraint violations on the real system. We introduce CoRE-MPC, a robust MPC formulation that plans with a nonlinear ROM and guarantees recursive feasibility and constraint satisfaction for the full-order system. It can be applied with a broad class of nonlinear model reduction techniques and the resulting MPC does not require evaluating the full-order model online, thus ensuring computational efficiency. The key insight is in how the ROM affects the dynamics of the prediction error. We account for this with two error radii that are propagated alongside the ROM and provide a guaranteed bound on the prediction error. The approach is validated in simulation on an 80-state oscillator chain, a Burgers equation, and a 9,768-state finite-element soft robot, where a two-state ROM with data-driven bounds keeps all 1,628 nodes clear of a wall at a median solve time below 1 ms for a 20 ms control period. Across these examples, CoRE-MPC is 13 to 61 times faster than full-order robust MPC at only 27 to 35% higher closed-loop cost, whereas existing certified schemes are either infeasible or at least twice as conservative. Code: [released upon publication].
tldr: Introduces CoRE-MPC, a robust MPC scheme that uses nonlinear reduced-order models and two propagated error radii to guarantee full-order constraint satisfaction and recursive feasibility without online full-order model evaluation, validated on high-dimensional nonlinear systems including a soft robot.
tldr_zh: 提出 CoRE-MPC，一种基于非线性降阶模型的鲁棒模型预测控制方法，通过传播两个误差半径来保证全阶系统的约束满足与递归可行性，且在线无需评估全阶模型，并在包括软体机器人在内的高维非线性系统中得到验证。
summary_zh: 降阶模型（ROMs）使得高维非线性系统的模型预测控制（MPC）变得可行，但由此产生的建模误差可能导致真实系统上的约束违反。我们提出了CoRE-MPC，一种鲁棒MPC公式，它利用非线性ROM进行规划，并保证全阶系统的递推可行性与约束满足。该方法可应用于广泛类别的非线性模型降阶技术，且所得MPC无需在线评估全阶模型，从而确保计算效率。关键洞见在于ROM如何影响预测误差的动力学特性。我们通过两个误差半径来考虑这一点，这些误差半径与ROM一起传播，并为预测误差提供有保证的界。该方法在80状态振荡器链、Burgers方程以及一个9,768状态有限元软体机器人上进行了仿真验证，其中使用带有数据驱动边界的双状态ROM，在20 ms控制周期内，中位求解时间低于1 ms，同时使全部1,628个节点远离墙壁。在这些示例中，CoRE-MPC比全阶鲁棒MPC快13至61倍，闭环成本仅高出27%至35%，而现有认证方案要么不可行，要么保守性至少为其两倍。代码：[发布时公开]。

title: HEM-Med: A Hierarchical Agentic Memory Framework for Safe Multi-Center Medication Recommendation
summary: Medication recommendation (MR) is critical for clinical decision support. While existing MR methods are mostly designed for single-center learning, where only one independent hospital is involved, multi-center MR with hospitals of different scales has become increasingly demanding in practice. In multi center settings, abundant data from large medical centers can improve recommendation performance for low-resource centers. Despite a few preliminary attempts on this task, two critical gaps remain. Gap 1: Existing multi-center methods fail to disentangle transferable cross-hospital clinical experience from hospital-specific prescribing patterns, limiting clinical feasibility and physician acceptance. Gap 2: They commonly overlook multi label safety constraints of MR, including drug-drug interaction risks and local formulary feasibility, which are essential for safe real-world deployment. To address these gaps, we propose HEM-Med, a novel hierarchical agentic memory framework for multi-center MR. To address Gap 1, we design a disentangled hierarchical memory module that builds patient-level medication context attribution records and disentangles them into cross hospital experience memory and hospital-specific residual memory. To address Gap 2, we introduce a safety-aware medication set generation module, which integrates dual-level experience retrieval with safety-aware set decoding to produce clinically relevant, safer, and locally adaptive medication recommendations. Experiments on a real-world multi-center eICU dataset show that HEM-Med outperforms representative transfer learning, LLM-based, and MR baselines in terms of both recommendation accuracy and safety.
tldr: HEM-Med proposes a hierarchical agentic memory framework for multi-center medication recommendation, disentangling cross-hospital clinical experience from hospital-specific patterns and integrating safety-aware set decoding to reduce drug-drug interactions and improve formulary feasibility. Experiments on a real-world eICU dataset show improved accuracy and safety over baselines.
tldr_zh: HEM-Med 提出了一种面向多中心用药推荐的分层智能体记忆框架，将跨医院临床经验与医院特有处方模式进行解耦，并引入安全感知的集合生成，以降低药物相互作用风险并提高本地用药可行性。在真实 eICU 数据集上的实验表明其准确性和安全性优于基线方法。
summary_zh: 摘要：药物推荐（MR）对于临床决策支持至关重要。现有MR方法大多针对单中心学习设计，仅涉及一家独立医院，而实践中涉及不同规模医院的多中心MR需求日益增长。在多中心场景下，大型医疗中心的丰富数据能够提升低资源中心的推荐性能。尽管已有一些初步尝试，但该任务仍存在两个关键缺口。缺口1：现有多中心方法未能将可迁移的跨医院临床经验与医院特定的处方模式分离开来，限制了临床可行性和医生接受度。缺口2：它们普遍忽视了MR的多标签安全约束，包括药物相互作用风险和本地药物目录可行性，而这些对于安全地实际部署至关重要。为解决上述缺口，我们提出了HEM-Med，一种新颖的用于多中心MR的分层智能体记忆框架。针对缺口1，我们设计了一个解耦的分层记忆模块，该模块构建患者级别的用药情境归属记录，并将其解耦为跨医院经验记忆和医院特定残余记忆。针对缺口2，我们引入了一个安全感知的用药集合生成模块，该模块将双层经验检索与安全感知的集合解码相结合，以产生临床相关、更安全且具有本地适应性的药物推荐。在真实世界多中心eICU数据集上的实验表明，HEM-Med在推荐准确性和安全性方面均优于代表性的迁移学习、基于大语言模型及MR基线方法。

title: PRISMATIC : Prescription Risk Inspection System for Multi-Agent Treatment Interaction in Clinical Decision-Making
summary: Medical prescribing errors for multimorbid patients, who require complex drug regimens, are a major patient safety concern. These errors often stem from fragmented decision-making across medical specialties, a critical coordination failure that leads to adverse drug events and rehospitalizations. To address this coordination challenge, we introduce PRISMATIC, a multi-agent architecture where specialized agents, each representing a workflow role, collaboratively generate and refine treatment plans. Operating on a blackboard architecture, the system first structures patient information from clinical notes, then iteratively develops safe, rational, and interpretable drug regimens. The agents' collaboration is governed by two novel adaptive coordination mechanisms: (1) Dynamic Self-Updating Weight Adjustment (DSWA), a long-term mechanism that adjusts the influence weights of agents based on historical case outcomes, enabling the system to adapt and trust more reliable specialists over time. (2) Discrepancy Feedback Precise Calibration (DFPC), a short-term mechanism where agents provide iterative feedback to resolve disagreements and eliminate prescription conflicts for the current patient. Experiments on patient records from the MIMIC-IV database show that PRISMATIC significantly reduces drug conflicts, improves prescription coverage, and enhances treatment consistency compared to strong LLM baselines. Our work demonstrates that structuring clinical co-treatment as a multi-agent coordination problem offers a promising path toward safer and more coherent multidisease management.
tldr: PRISMATIC introduces a blackboard-based multi-agent system for collaborative medication planning, with two adaptive coordination mechanisms (DSWA and DFPC) that reduce drug conflicts and improve treatment consistency on MIMIC-IV.
tldr_zh: PRISMATIC 提出一种基于黑板架构的多智能体系统，通过动态权重调整与差异反馈校准两种协调机制，为多病共存患者生成更安全、合理且可解释的用药方案，并在 MIMIC-IV 上优于强 LLM 基线。
summary_zh: 摘要：对于需要复杂用药方案的多病共存患者而言，医疗处方错误是一个重大的患者安全问题。这些错误往往源于不同医学专科之间分散化的决策，这种关键的协调失败会导致药物不良事件和再入院。为应对这一协调挑战，我们提出了PRISMATIC，一种多智能体架构，其中每个专业化智能体代表一个工作流角色，协作生成并优化治疗方案。该系统基于黑板架构运行，首先从临床记录中结构化患者信息，然后迭代地制定安全、合理且可解释的药物方案。智能体间的协作由两种新颖的自适应协调机制驱动：(1) 动态自更新权重调整（DSWA），一种长期机制，根据历史病例结果调整智能体的影响权重，使系统能够随时间的推移适应并信任更可靠的专业智能体；(2) 差异反馈精确校准（DFPC），一种短期机制，智能体通过迭代反馈解决分歧并消除当前患者的处方冲突。在MIMIC-IV数据库患者记录上的实验表明，与强大语言模型基线相比，PRISMATIC显著减少了药物冲突、提高了处方覆盖率并增强了治疗一致性。我们的工作表明，将临床协同治疗构建为多智能体协调问题，为实现更安全、更一致的多疾病管理提供了一条有前景的途径。

title: EpiGuard: An Autonomous Infectious-Disease Early Warning Agent Platform
summary: Infectious disease outbreaks often spread rapidly before signs of widespread transmission become apparent, leaving a big challenge for rapid response and effective intervention. However, current infectious-disease early-warning systems face three major challenges: fragmented epidemiological evidence across diverse surveillance sources, highly uneven data availability across diseases and geographic regions, and delayed warning procedure caused by manual data collection, analysis, and reporting. To address these challenges, we present EpiGuard, an autonomous, continually self-improving agentic platform for timely and reliable early warning of more than 50 infectious diseases across different regions. EpiGuard proactively monitors and captures newly released official surveillance records, using the latest available evidence for risk assessments. It dynamically adjusts its analytical strategy across three evidence availability regimes, enabling reliable risk assessment under diverse data conditions, ranging from the absence of historical observations to sparse and abundant evidence. Moreover, EpiGuard learns from the successful execution process by preserving effective data-acquisition and analytical procedures as reusable standard operating procedures, enabling it to progressively generalize to previously unseen diseases and regions. We use officially released infectious-disease surveillance data from the China CDC and the United States CDC to evaluate EpiGuard's effectiveness. Experimental results demonstrate that EpiGuard outperforms state-of-the-art forecasting systems, improving forecasting performance by 9.68% and 14.04% on the China CDC and U.S. CDC datasets, respectively.
tldr: EpiGuard is an autonomous agentic platform for early warning of infectious diseases that continuously monitors surveillance data, adapts its risk-assessment strategy based on data availability, and learns reusable standard operating procedures; it improves forecasting by ~10-14% over SOTA on China and US CDC data.
tldr_zh: EpiGuard 是一个自主智能体平台，用于传染病早期预警，可持续监测监测数据、根据数据可用性调整风险评估策略，并学习可复用的标准操作流程；在中国和美国CDC数据上相比SOTA预测性能提升约10%-14%。
summary_zh: 传染病暴发往往在广泛传播迹象显现之前就已迅速蔓延，这给快速响应和有效干预带来了巨大挑战。然而，当前的传染病早期预警系统面临三大挑战：来自多种监测来源的流行病学证据碎片化、不同疾病和地理区域之间数据可用性高度不均衡，以及因人工数据收集、分析和报告而导致的预警流程延迟。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了EpiGuard——一个自主、持续自我改进的智能体平台，可对不同地区50余种传染病进行及时可靠的早期预警。EpiGuard主动监测并获取最新发布的官方监测记录，利用最新的可用证据进行风险评估。它能在三种证据可用性情境下动态调整其分析策略，从而在从缺乏历史观测到证据稀疏乃至证据丰富的多种数据条件下实现可靠的风险评估。此外，EpiGuard通过将有效的数据获取和分析流程保存为可复用的标准操作程序，从成功的执行过程中学习，使其能够逐步泛化到此前未见过的疾病和地区。我们使用中国疾控中心和美国疾控中心官方发布的传染病监测数据来评估EpiGuard的有效性。实验结果表明，EpiGuard优于最先进的预测系统，在中国疾控中心和美国疾控中心数据集上的预测性能分别提升了9.68%和14.04%。

title: SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models
summary: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.
tldr: SonoWorld proposes a causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model for robotic ultrasound simulation. It trains a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on unlabeled clinical ultrasound videos, grounds the learned dynamics to 6-DoF probe poses with a small EM-tracked dataset, and uses distillation for interactive long-horizon generation, enabling model-based policy evaluation and action discrimination.
tldr_zh: SonoWorld 提出一种用于机器人超声模拟的因果、位姿可控超声世界模型。它在未标注临床超声视频上训练潜在动作条件视频扩散模型，利用少量 EM 跟踪数据将学习到的视频动态与 6 自由度探头位姿对齐，并通过蒸馏实现交互式长时程生成，支持基于模型的策略评估与动作判别。
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人超声可以标准化图像采集并减少操作者工作负担和变异性，但策略学习仍受限于缺乏逼真、可控的仿真环境。尽管可控世界模型在自然图像领域已取得快速发展，超声世界建模仍然具有挑战性，因为每一帧仅捕获未观测三维解剖结构的某一截面，导致微小的探头运动即可引发大幅度的外观变化。现有方法依赖于机器人跟踪的位姿和潜在空间预测，但并未直接生成交互控制所需的观测数据。我们提出SonoWorld，一种因果超声世界模型，它从无标签的临床视频中学习视频动态，并利用一小部分由电磁传感器跟踪的徒手临床扫描将其映射到六自由度控制。SonoWorld分三个阶段进行训练：首先在约690万帧无标签的多器官超声帧上预训练一个潜在动作条件视频扩散模型；然后利用小型电磁跟踪甲状腺数据集将所学视频动态映射到度量探头位姿；最后应用分布匹配蒸馏，实现因果、长程自回归生成，并在推理时选择性地缓存驱逐令牌。我们通过位姿跟随保真度、往返一致性以及合成动作下的轴特定控制来评估可控性，并在留出的跟踪扫描上进行验证，同时结合用户研究进一步确认。在基于模型的动作判别中，SonoWorld在多达74.8%的试验中正确地将目标导向的探头运动排序在等幅相反运动之前。据我们所知，SonoWorld是首个主要从徒手临床视频中学习的因果、位姿可控超声世界模型，为机器人超声数据采集和策略评估提供了数据驱动的交互式环境。

title: A Master-to-Simulation Interface with Demonstration-Trajectory Guidance for Vascular Intervention
summary: Robotic vascular intervention can reduce radiation exposure to physicians and improve manipulation stability, but effective guidance remains challenging because conventional fluoroscopic images provide limited spatial information. This paper developed a vascular intervention interactive system that connects a real robotic master controller with the SOFA(Simulation Open Framework Architecture) physical simulation platform and reused successful operation trajectories as visual guidance in physical phantom experiments. Experiments were conducted to validate the master-to-SOFA control loop and to compare three guidance conditions: no guidance, centerline guidance, and successful-trajectory guidance. The control validation results showed reliable command delivery under velocity-mode operation. In the physical phantom experiment, centerline guidance showed no obvious improvement over no guidance. In contrast, successful trajectory guidance provided a clear performance benefit. Compared with the no-guidance condition, it reduced task completion time, collision number, rollback number, and rotation number by approximately 66.8%, 34.3%, 55.6%, and 66.7%, respectively. These results indicate that successful trajectories obtained under instrument-vessel interaction can provide practical guidance cues, offering a simple and effective visual assistance strategy for robotic vascular intervention experiments.
tldr: This paper presents a master-to-SOFA simulation interface for robotic vascular intervention and evaluates a demonstration-trajectory visual guidance method in phantom experiments, showing reduced task time, collisions, rollbacks, and rotations compared with no guidance or centerline guidance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于血管介入手术机器人的主端到SOFA仿真接口，并在体模实验中评估了基于成功操作轨迹的视觉引导方法，结果显示该方法相较于无引导和中心线引导能显著减少任务时间、碰撞、回退和旋转次数。
summary_zh: 血管介入机器人能够减少医生受到的辐射暴露，并提高操作稳定性，但有效的引导仍然具有挑战性，因为传统荧光图像提供的空间信息有限。本文开发了一套血管介入交互系统，将真实的机器人主手控制器与SOFA（仿真开放框架架构）物理仿真平台相连接，并在物理仿体实验中复用成功操作轨迹作为视觉引导。实验验证了主手到SOFA的控制回路，并比较了三种引导条件：无引导、中心线引导和成功轨迹引导。控制验证结果表明，在速度模式下指令传递可靠。在物理仿体实验中，中心线引导相比无引导没有明显改善；相反，成功轨迹引导带来了明显的性能提升。与无引导条件相比，任务完成时间、碰撞次数、回退次数和旋转次数分别减少了约66.8%、34.3%、55.6%和66.7%。这些结果表明，在器械-血管交互下获得的成功轨迹能够提供实用的引导线索，为血管介入机器人实验提供了一种简单有效的视觉辅助策略。
